text:
Jamie: Heads-up  ran into a weird overflow on small widths when sidebar slides in on mobile. Table gets a horizontal scrollbar and action buttons get pushed off-screen. Screenshot: https://redwood.app/s/overflow-1
Priya: I think this is two problems: (1) our table assumes 4 columns minimum, (2) sidebar uses transform: translateX which still keeps original layout width.
Marco: Repro on iPhone SE simulator. When sidebar toggles, main content width doesn't recalc so table overflow appears.
Ana: Quick idea: switch to compact-list mode below 380px and keep a single-column table for 380-420px with horizontal snap. Product prefers keeping table >380 for power users.
Jamie: Agreed with breakpoints: <380 -> compact cards, 380-420 -> condensed table, >420 -> full table. Add a visual indicator for horizontal scroll if condensed table overflows.
Priya: For the sidebar sliding, use position: fixed + width change instead of transform to let layout recalc. But that can be jankier. Alternative: trigger a resize event after animation completes.
Marco: Sample approach: ```js
// after sidebar open animation
requestAnimationFrame(() => window.dispatchEvent(new Event('resize')));
```
Marco: or set document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--content-width', computedWidth + 'px') during animation.
Ana: Accessibility: when we collapse to cards, we lose column headers. Need to surface key labels (status, model, cost) in each card and ensure aria-labels include those. Also: current focus order puts the sidebar close button after other interactive elements. Need to trap focus inside sidebar when open.
AccessibilityBot: Reminder: add aria-modal="true" on sidebar and aria-hidden="true" on inert background. Also ensure focus returned to the toggle when sidebar closes.
Jamie: Copy tweak: empty table message currently says "No runs". Product asked for clearer guidance: change to "No runs match your filters" and beneath it add small hint: "Try clearing filters or widen date range." Also add an aria-live polite update when filters change count.
Priya: Visual polish: when table shows truncated cell content, add subtle gradient mask at right edge rather than hard ellipsis so copy still readable in full view. Consider text-overflow: ellipsis for compact rows though.
Marco: QA request: add tests for orientation changes (portrait/landscape), foldable hinge cases, and keyboard navigation with VoiceOver/TalkBack. Also include a visual diff for the compact-card layout. @visual-regression-bot can you add that?
visual-regression-bot: Added job "mobile-compact-cards-diff" to canary. Will run on next push.
Ana: Implementation note: for sticky filter bar, avoid position: fixed globals. Use position: sticky within the scroll container: ```css
.filters { position: sticky; top: var(--header-height); z-index: 5; }
```
Ana: This prevents it from jumping under the sidebar if we keep stacking contexts correct. Also ensure z-index of sidebar > filters when open.
Priya: I'll prototype: (1) compact-card breakpoint CSS, (2) sidebar focus-trap util, (3) resize dispatch after animation. I'll include before/after screenshots + accessibility checklist in the PR.
Jamie: Prioritize P2. If visual-regression-bot finds regressions in canary, escalate. Tagging design for review tomorrow 10am. :calendar:
